title: Talking to a Stranger at the Bar
meta: B2 · 约 250 词 · 场景：酒吧和陌生人搭话与告别

lines.zh: 不好意思，这儿有人坐吗？

lines.en: Thanks. That looks good. What are you drinking, if you don't mind me asking?
lines.zh: 谢谢。你那杯看着不错。冒昧问一下，你喝的是什么？

lines.en: It's a local ==craft== beer, a bit fruity. The bartender __talked me into__ it, and I'm glad he did.
lines.zh: 本地的一款精酿啤酒，有点果香。是酒保推荐的，还好我听了他的。

lines.en: Maybe I'll try one too. Do you come here often? It's my first time.
lines.zh: 那我也来一杯吧。你常来这儿吗？我是第一次来。

lines.en: Most Fridays, actually. It's close to my office. You don't sound like you're from around here.
lines.zh: 其实差不多每个周五都来，离我公司近。听口音你不是本地人吧？

lines.en: No, I'm originally from China. I moved here with my family about two years ago. What about you?
lines.zh: 不是，我是中国人。大概两年前带着家人搬过来的。你呢？

lines.en: I'm from Manchester. I came out on a two-year ==posting== and somehow never left.
lines.zh: 我是曼彻斯特人。本来是公司外派两年，结果不知怎么就留下来了。

lines.en: That __happens a lot__ here, doesn't it? The weather ==grows on you==.
lines.zh: 这种事在这儿挺常见的，对吧？天气慢慢就让人习惯了。

scenes.heading: 2. Keeping It Going, Then Wrapping Up

lines.en: So what do you do? Let me guess, something in tech?
lines.zh: 那你是做什么的？我猜猜，搞技术的？

lines.en: Good guess. I manage a team at a tech company. And you?
lines.zh: 猜对了。我在一家科技公司带团队。你呢？

lines.en: I'm in ==logistics==, which is rather less glamorous. Mostly ==chasing== ships around the region.
lines.zh: 我做物流，没那么光鲜。基本上就是在区域里到处追船期。

lines.en: **Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Did you say chasing ships?**
lines.zh: 不好意思，我没太听清。你是说追船吗？

lines.en: Ha, yes. Tracking shipments that are late, basically. It's less exciting than it sounds.
lines.zh: 哈，对。说白了就是盯那些延误的货。没听起来那么刺激。

lines.en: Still sounds more exciting than my meetings. Any good places around here you'd ==recommend==?
lines.zh: 那也比我开会有意思。这附近有什么好地方推荐吗？

lines.en: There's a little jazz bar two streets down. Quiet, decent wine, no one shouting.
lines.zh: 往前两条街有个小爵士酒吧。安静，红酒不错，没人大吵大闹。

lines.en: I'll __check it out__. Well, I should __head off__. My son gets up at six, so no late nights for me.
lines.zh: 我去看看。好了，我得走了。我儿子六点就起，我可熬不了夜。

lines.en: **It was really nice chatting with you. I'm Lee, by the way.**
lines.zh: 跟你聊天很开心。对了，我叫 Lee。

lines.en: Sophie. Nice to meet you, Lee. Maybe see you here next Friday.
lines.zh: 我叫 Sophie。很高兴认识你，Lee。说不定下周五这儿见。

gist.a: 先问旁边的座位有没有人，再问对方喝的是什么酒。

gist.q: 对方是哪里人、做什么工作？
gist.a: 来自曼彻斯特，原本外派两年后留在了这里，做物流，主要追踪延误的货运。
说儿子六点就起床，不能太晚，然后自我介绍并道别。

prompts.q: 在朋友的生日聚会上，你旁边站着一个谁都不认识的人。主动搭话：介绍自己、说明你和寿星的关系，再问对方一个问题。
prompts.ref: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Lee. I know Daniel from work, we sit on the same floor. How do you know him? I have to say, this is a great place for a party. Have you been here before? I'm always looking for somewhere new to take my family on weekends.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我们好像还没见过。我叫 Lee，跟 Daniel 是同事，在同一层办公。你是怎么认识他的？说真的，这地方办聚会真不错。你以前来过吗？我周末总在找新地方带家人去。

prompts.q: 在酒吧有人一直拉着你聊，你想礼貌地结束对话回到朋友那边。说一段既得体又明确的话。
prompts.ref: Sorry, I'm going to have to steal myself away. My friends are waiting for me over there, and I promised I'd only be a minute. It was really good talking to you, though. Good luck with the new job, and enjoy the rest of your night.
prompts.ref_zh: 不好意思，我得先走开一下了。我朋友在那边等我，我说好只离开一会儿的。不过跟你聊得很开心。新工作顺利，今晚玩得开心。
